purpose: Single source of the Silverleaf offer terms that outreach messages may state. Message scripts in scripts/messaging/ read this file; verification checks every percentage and amount in a message against it.
status: Terms come from Silverleaf's 2025 discount schedule and its 2025 Rivertrees proposal. The 2027 fee structure and discount approvals were in progress on the 2027 enrolment plan (tasks A1 and A2, due 15 September 2026). Confirm with Finance that each term applies to the 2027 school year before any message is sent.

offers.name: Free uniform for full-year payment
offers.terms: A full school uniform set, worth TZS 110,000, free when the year's tuition is paid in full before the new school year opens. It cannot be used to pay tuition.
offers.terms_sw: Sare kamili ya shule bure (yenye thamani ya TZS 110,000) kwa mzazi anayelipa ada ya masomo ya mwaka mzima kabla shule haijafunguliwa. Haiwezi kutumika kulipia ada.

offers.name: Sibling discount
offers.audience: Parents with more than one child at Silverleaf (biological siblings)
offers.terms: 10% off tuition for a third child and 20% for a fourth, for as long as they study at Silverleaf. None for the first two children.
offers.terms_sw: Punguzo la asilimia 10 ya ada ya masomo kwa mtoto wa tatu na asilimia 20 kwa mtoto wa nne (ndugu wa damu), kwa muda wote wakiwa Silverleaf.

offers.name: NGO partner discount
offers.audience: NGOs (orphanages and children's homes) that place all their primary-age children at Silverleaf
offers.terms: Per child, off tuition: 3% for 10 children, 6% for 20, 9% for 30, 12% for 40, 15% for 50 and 18% for 60.
offers.terms_sw: Kwa kila mtoto: punguzo la asilimia 3 kwa watoto 10, 6 kwa 20, 9 kwa 30, 12 kwa 40, 15 kwa 50 na 18 kwa watoto 60.

offers.name: Institutional staff discount
offers.audience: Staff of organisations and government bodies
offers.terms: 20% off tuition for heads of department, for as long as their child studies at Silverleaf; 10% off the first year for all other staff.
offers.terms_sw: Punguzo la asilimia 20 ya ada kwa wakuu wa idara kwa muda wote mtoto akiwa Silverleaf, na asilimia 10 kwa mwaka wa kwanza kwa watumishi wengine.
offers.restriction: Never in a convening request to a government office: a personal benefit offered to officials whose cooperation Silverleaf is seeking could look like an inducement (plans/b2b-government-leads-plan.md §3, anti-corruption). Offer it to a public body only as an employee benefit through its HR route, after a compliance check.

offers.name: Referral uniform package
offers.terms: Uniform package worth TZS 30,000 for students enrolling before 30 November 2024 for the 2025 school year.
offers.use_note: Expired. The 2027 referral scheme is under review (Gantt A8); no referral reward may appear in a message until it is approved.

offers.name: ECD owner facilitation
offers.audience: Owners or managers of early-childhood development (ECD) centres
offers.terms: TZS 50,000 per Daycare or Pre-Primary student enrolled in January, paid to the ECD owner or manager and described as a facilitation commission.
offers.use_note: Only for ECD-centre leads, which none of the current lists hold. Never offer it to parents, officials or welfare institutions.

offers.name: Member association rate (KINEFA)
offers.terms: Per student, off tuition: 7% at 50 students, 12% at 100 and 17% at 150.
offers.terms_sw: Kwa kila mwanafunzi: punguzo la asilimia 7 wanafunzi 50 wakijiunga, 12 kwa 100 na 17 kwa 150.
offers.use_note: Documented for KINEFA members only. Savings-group messages may say Silverleaf agrees group rates with member associations, starting at 7% per student at 50 students, and each message carries a condition that Finance must agree to extend it.

offers.name: Corporate Education Benefit Partnership (Rivertrees 2025)
offers.terms: 40% off tuition for employees' children; admission fee (TZS 50,000) waived for those joining that year; monthly or quarterly instalments for tuition and transport; access to school facilities; invitations to parent events and workshops; priority enrolment subject to availability. Benefits to the employer: staff well-being and retention, community building, employer branding (the employer may co-fund the remaining fee and present it as its own benefit), family development sessions.
offers.use_note: Negotiated with Rivertrees after a meeting; quote its terms only to Rivertrees. For other employers it is the model for the proposal that follows a meeting, not an opening offer.

offers.name: Four-instalment tuition
offers.terms: Tuition is paid in four instalments across the year.
offers.terms_sw: Ada ya masomo hulipwa kwa awamu nne kwa mwaka.

rules: State an offer's terms exactly as recorded here, including its condition (for example, all primary-age children for OF03; payment before the school year opens for OF01).
Do not quote tuition figures in a first message. Offer the current fee schedule instead, because the 2027 fees were still being approved.
Never mention OF05 (expired referral reward) or any referral reward.
OF08's 40% applies to Rivertrees only. OF07's group rate is KINEFA's and needs Finance to extend it.
Government convening letters describe the family offer for parents only (OF01, OF02, OF09). They never offer officials or their staff a discount (OF04 restriction).
No offer guarantees a place, transport route or capacity; admissions confirms each family's level and campus.
Every message records its offer IDs and carries the condition that Finance confirms the terms for 2027 before sending.
